issue_description: Our backend service started returning a 403 error immediately after we upgraded to the Growth plan yesterday. The same API key was working before the upgrade. We already regenerated the key once but requests are still failing from our staging environment.
resolution: The redirect loop occurred because the OAuth callback URL in your Google Workspace app included a trailing slash that did not match the value stored in NexaSupport. We updated the Authorized Redirect URI under Integrations > OAuth Apps. After clearing the old consent session and reauthorizing the application, authentication completed successfully. We also enabled debug logging for the next 48 hours.

issue_description: The API authentication endpoint intermittently returns a 500 error during peak hours. Retrying the same request sometimes works. We need help identifying whether this is related to our token configuration.
tags: SSO login, Azure AD, redirect loop
resolution: We confirmed the plan upgrade created a secondary API workspace and the old key was scoped to the inactive workspace. Navigate to Settings > Developer > API Keys and generate a key under the active workspace ID. We also reset the permission cache tied to your tenant. After updating the X-API-KEY header in your staging environment, the 403 responses stopped. Please monitor the API Audit tab for the next 24 hours.

issue_description: Users are getting logged out every 20 minutes even though our session timeout is configured for 8 hours. We noticed repeated JWT expired messages in the audit logs. This issue started after enabling SSO with Azure AD.
tags: SSO login, Azure AD, redirect loop
resolution: Our investigation showed the JWT token expiry value in the SSO configuration was set to 1200 seconds instead of 28800 seconds. We updated the Session Timeout field under Security > Authentication Policies. Your Azure AD metadata was also refreshed to remove stale claims. Users should now maintain sessions correctly across browser refreshes. We recommend clearing cached cookies once before retesting.

issue_description: The API authentication endpoint intermittently returns a 500 error during peak hours. Retrying the same request sometimes works. We need help identifying whether this is related to our token configuration.
resolution: We identified that your nightly sync process was using three parallel workers with the same API token, causing the combined request volume to exceed the tenant-level rate limit. We increased the burst threshold temporarily and recommended adding exponential backoff logic. You can review request counts under Developer Console > Usage Metrics. After reducing concurrency, no additional 429 errors were observed.

issue_description: Microsoft Teams notifications fail with a permissions error after reauthorizing the integration. The integration status page still shows connected. We need help identifying which permission scope is missing.
resolution: The Microsoft Teams integration was missing the ChannelMessage.Send permission after reauthorization. We updated the app registration in Azure and validated the new permission scope through the integration health check. Notifications resumed immediately after the tenant consent was approved. We also documented the required scopes in your workspace notes.

issue_description: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing new leads after the latest API version update. Historical records are still visible. The sync logs show repeated field mapping validation failures.
resolution: We identified that Salesforce API version 61 deprecated the LeadSource mapping field used in your sync configuration. The field mapping was updated under Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping. After re-running the sync job, new leads processed successfully. We also enabled schema validation alerts for future API version changes.

issue_description: Slack notifications for support ticket updates are delayed by more than 30 minutes. The webhook test message works instantly from the settings page. Only automated workflow alerts are delayed.
resolution: The delayed Slack notifications were caused by a backlog in the workflow event queue tied to your automation rules. We restarted the queue processor and optimized the webhook retry interval. Notifications are now being delivered within normal latency ranges. You can monitor webhook health under Integrations > Slack > Diagnostics.

Historical contacts were backfilled successfully.
